models.name: twilio__account_overview
models.description: This model provides aggregate information per each account regarding the Twilio Messages resource.

columns.name: account_id
columns.description: The unique identifier for account.

columns.name: account_name
columns.description: Friendly name associated with the account.

columns.name: account_status
columns.description: The status or state of the account.

columns.name: account_type
columns.description: The type or category of the account.

columns.name: date_day
columns.description: The day of the message activity.

columns.name: date_week
columns.description: The week of the message activity.

columns.name: date_month
columns.description: The month of the message activity.

columns.name: price_unit
columns.description: The currency unit in which the `price` is measured.

columns.name: total_outbound_messages
columns.description: Total number of outbound messages for this account.

columns.name: total_inbound_messages
columns.description: Total number of inbound messages for this account.

columns.name: total_accepted_messages
columns.description: Total number of accepted messages for this account.

columns.name: total_scheduled_messages
columns.description: Total number of scheduled messages for this account.

columns.name: total_canceled_messages
columns.description: Total number of canceled messages for this account.

columns.name: total_queued_messages
columns.description: Total number of queued messages for this account.

columns.name: total_sending_messages
columns.description: Total number of sending messages for this account.

columns.name: total_sent_messages
columns.description: Total number of sent messages for this account.

columns.name: total_failed_messages
columns.description: Total number of failed messages for this account.

columns.name: total_delivered_messages
columns.description: Total number of delivered messages for this account.

columns.name: total_undelivered_messages
columns.description: Total number of undelivered messages for this account.

columns.name: total_receiving_messages
columns.description: Total number of receiving messages for this account.

columns.name: total_received_messages
columns.description: Total number of received messages for this account.

columns.name: total_read_messages
columns.description: Total number of read messages for this account.

columns.name: total_messages
columns.description: Total number of messages for this account.

columns.name: total_messages_spend
columns.description: Total cost or price associated with this account.

config:
Airbyte:
  config:
    files_definition_id: 778daa7c-feaf-4db6-96f3-70fd645acc77
    mongodb_definition_id: b2e713cd-cc36-4c0a-b5bd-b47cb8a0561e
    namespace_definition: destination
    postgres_definition_id: decd338e-5647-4c0b-adf4-da0e75f5a750
    s3_definition_id: 69589781-7828-43c5-9f63-8925b1c1ccc2
    server_url: http://airbyte-abctl-control-plane:80/api/public/v1/
    redshift_definition_id: f7a7d195-377f-cf5b-70a5-be6b819019dc
aws_s3:
  AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID: test
  AWS_DEFAULT_REGION: us-west-2
  AWS_ENDPOINT_URL: http://elt-localstack:4566
  AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY: test
  data:
  - path: s3://twilio-bucket/account_history.jsonl
    sync_mode: full_refresh_append
    table: account_history
  - path: s3://twilio-bucket/incoming_phone_number.jsonl
    sync_mode: full_refresh_append
    table: incoming_phone_number
custom_api:
  config:
    configuration: {}
    sync_mode: full_refresh_append
    tables:
    - messaging_service
    - outgoing_caller_id
flat_files:
- format: jsonl
  path: https://drive.google.com/uc?export=download&id=1TC1Q1WYLy5dwcGVASc5YsklQbTijDX_k
  sync_mode: full_refresh_append
  table: usage_record
- format: csv
  path: https://drive.google.com/uc?export=download&id=149V3-6Bbs_lUgIMSpc0Rp3Bme4wRowvj
  sync_mode: full_refresh_append
  table: address
mongodb:
  config:
    connection_string: mongodb://elt-mongodb:27017/?directConnection=true
    database: twilio
    sync_mode: full_refresh_append
    tables:
    - call
postgres:
  config:
    database: twilio
    host: elt-postgres
    password: testelt
    port: 5432
    schema: public
    sync_mode: full_refresh_append
    tables:
    - message
    user: postgres
redshift:
  config:
    host: <redshift_hostname>
    port: <redshift_port>
    database: <redshift_db>
    username: <redshift_username>
    password: <redshift_pwd>
    schema: twilio
    s3_bucket_name: <redshift_s3_bucket>
    s3_bucket_region: <redshift_s3_region>
    access_key_id: <redshift_s3_access_key>
    secret_access_key: <redshift_s3_secret_key>
